1 /**
2  * TW1 — Campaign Roadmap: append-only roadmap_events[] + derived roadmap_projection.
3  *
4  * The Roadmap is engine truth. Face prose is never the only step list: when a
5  * project has only prose, the projection is EMPTY with an honest gap — steps
6  * are never invented from narrative.
7  *
8  * SINGLE WRITER PATH (TW3 hook — do not dual-write):
9  * - The only writer is appendRoadmapEvent (via roadmap-propose / roadmap-set).
10  * - roadmap_projection is derived-only: rebuilt from the full event list on
11  *   every append; direct projection writes are rejected
12  *   (mutateRoadmapProjectionInPlace always refuses).
13  * - TW3 job lifecycle (commission propose/confirm, queued→running→done|failed|
14  *   orphaned|reaped) must bind through this same writer: commission_bind to
15  *   attach a step to a commissioned job, status_flip (receipt required) for
16  *   step status changes. No second store, no UI-only state, no direct
17  *   projection writes. See ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER.tw3_hook.
18  *
19  * Silent-rewrite law (mirrors Strip heal law):
20  * - status flip without a receipt → refuse write (append) / reject (rebuild).
21  * - stored projection that disagrees with the event fold → reject
22  *   (roadmap_silent_rewrite); heal = rebuild projection from events.
23  * - roadmap_events history is never rewritten — heal touches projection only.
24  */

224 /**
225  * Normalize / validate a roadmap container (object or JSON string).
226  * @param {object|string|null} input
227  * @returns {{ ok: true, roadmap: object } | { ok: false, error: string, message?: string }}
228  */
229 export function parseRoadmap(input) {
230   let roadmap = input;
231   if (typeof input === 'string') {
232     try {
233       roadmap = JSON.parse(input);
234     } catch (e) {
235       return { ok: false, error: 'roadmap_json_parse', message: String(e?.message ?? e) };
236     }
237   }
238   if (!roadmap || typeof roadmap !== 'object' || Array.isArray(roadmap)) {
239     return { ok: false, error: 'roadmap_not_object' };
240   }
241   const out = { ...roadmap };
242   if (!out.schema) out.schema = ROADMAP_SCHEMA_ID;
243   out.roadmap_events = Array.isArray(out.roadmap_events)
244     ? out.roadmap_events.map((e) => ({ ...e }))
245     : [];
246   out.roadmap_projection = Array.isArray(out.roadmap_projection)
247     ? out.roadmap_projection.map((s) => ({ ...s }))
248     : [];
249   return { ok: true, roadmap: out };
250 }

263 /**
264  * Normalize a projection step to the locked field set (stable order).
265  * @param {object} step
266  */
267 /** W0 (High Seat, 2026-09-26): an optional calendar date on a step — ISO YYYY-MM-DD only, nothing else. */
268 export const ROADMAP_DUE_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
269 export function normalizeDue(v) {
270   if (typeof v !== 'string') return null;
271   const s = v.trim();
272   if (!ROADMAP_DUE_PATTERN.test(s)) return null;
273   const d = new Date(`${s}T00:00:00Z`);
274   return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) || d.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== s ? null : s;
275 }

277 /**
278  * W0b (High Seat, 2026-09-26): three more optional step fields, validated by value like `part`.
279  *  ref  — a part that points at another record: project:<pid> · step:<pid>/<sid> · deliverable:<pid>/<row> · calendar:<id>.
280  *         A step with a ref carries no due and is never flipped here (its own record owns date and state).
281  *  tier — an initiative's priority tier, 1 · 2 · 3, on its heading step.
282  *  area — an initiative's life area, one of six tags, on its heading step.
283  */
284 export const ROADMAP_REF_PREFIXES = Object.freeze(['project', 'step', 'deliverable', 'calendar', 'effort']);   // effort:<pid>/<dir> — one cockpit within a project (2026-09-30)
285 export const ROADMAP_AREA_TAGS = Object.freeze(['family', 'professional', 'writing', 'research', 'tools', 'personal']);
286 export function normalizeRef(v) {
287   if (typeof v !== 'string') return null;
288   const s = v.trim();
289   const m = /^([a-z]+):(\S+)$/.exec(s);
290   if (!m || !ROADMAP_REF_PREFIXES.includes(m[1])) return null;
291   if ((m[1] === 'step' || m[1] === 'deliverable' || m[1] === 'effort') && !/^[^/]+\/[^/]+$/.test(m[2])) return null;
292   if (m[1] === 'effort') { const dir = m[2].split('/')[1]; if (dir === '.' || dir === '..' || /\\/.test(dir)) return null; }   // one directory inside the project, never a step out (Grok, W2b)
293   return s;
294 }
295 export function normalizeTier(v) {
296   const n = typeof v === 'string' && /^\s*[123]\s*$/.test(v) ? Number(v) : v;
297   return Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 3 ? n : null;
298 }
299 export function normalizeArea(v) {
300   if (typeof v !== 'string') return null;
301   const s = v.trim().toLowerCase();
302   return ROADMAP_AREA_TAGS.includes(s) ? s : null;
303 }
304 const REF_FIELD_NORMALIZERS = Object.freeze({
305   ref: [normalizeRef, 'invalid_ref'],
306   tier: [normalizeTier, 'invalid_tier'],
307   area: [normalizeArea, 'unknown_area_tag'],
308 });
309 function otherStepWithRef(steps, id, ref) {
310   for (const [oid, os] of steps) if (oid !== id && os && os.ref === ref) return oid;
311   return null;
312 }
313 
314 export function normalizePartTag(raw) {
315   const v = String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
316   return ROADMAP_PART_TAGS.includes(v) ? v : null;
317 }

319 export function normalizeProjectionStep(step = {}) {
320   const gate = step.gate;
321   const hasKickoffProjection = Array.isArray(step.component_ids)
322     || step.end_to_end_slice != null
323     || step.kickoff_version != null
324     || step.kickoff_proposal_hash != null;
325   const componentIds = Array.isArray(step.component_ids)
326     ? [...new Set(step.component_ids.map(String).filter(Boolean))]
327     : [];
328   const normalized = {
329     id: step.id ?? null,
330     name: step.name ?? null,
331     status: step.status ?? null,
332     done_when: step.done_when ?? null,
333     waiting_on: step.waiting_on ?? null,
334     commissioned_as: step.commissioned_as ?? null,
335     part: normalizePartTag(step.part),
336     gate: typeof gate === 'string' && gate.trim() ? gate.trim() : null,
337   };
338   if (hasKickoffProjection) {
339     normalized.component_ids = componentIds;
340     normalized.end_to_end_slice = step.end_to_end_slice === true;
341     normalized.kickoff_version = Number.isInteger(step.kickoff_version)
342       ? step.kickoff_version : null;
343     normalized.kickoff_proposal_hash = typeof step.kickoff_proposal_hash === 'string'
344       && step.kickoff_proposal_hash.trim()
345       ? step.kickoff_proposal_hash.trim()
346       : null;
347   }
348   if (step.due != null) normalized.due = step.due;
349   if (step.ref != null) normalized.ref = step.ref;
350   if (step.tier != null) normalized.tier = step.tier;
351   if (step.area != null) normalized.area = step.area;
352   if (step.active === true) normalized.active = true;
353   if (Number.isInteger(step.active_order)) normalized.active_order = step.active_order;
354   if (step.pace != null) normalized.pace = step.pace;
355   if (step.seat === 'active' || step.seat === 'deck') normalized.seat = step.seat;
356   if (Number.isInteger(step.seat_order)) normalized.seat_order = step.seat_order;
357   // the Star Chart (2026-10-03): a goal's if-then step survives the projection; null or blank clears it (Grok code R1 F1)
358   if (typeof step.if_then === 'string' && step.if_then.trim()) normalized.if_then = step.if_then.trim();
359   if (step.navigation != null) normalized.navigation = structuredClone(step.navigation);
360   if (step.refinement) normalized.refinement = step.refinement;
361   return normalized;
362 }

364 /**
365  * Fold the append-only event list into the derived projection.
366  * A status_flip without a valid receipt is NOT applied (issue recorded) —
367  * silent flips cannot enter the step list even from a hand-authored file.
368  * @param {object[]} events
369  * @returns {{ ok: true, projection: object[], issues: object[], clean: boolean }}
370  */
371 export function buildRoadmapProjection(events = []) {
372   const list = Array.isArray(events) ? events : [];
373   const steps = new Map();
374   const issues = [];
375 
376   list.forEach((ev, idx) => {
377     if (!ev || typeof ev !== 'object') {
378       issues.push({ code: 'event_not_object', at_index: idx });
379       return;
380     }
381     if (typeof ev.seq === 'number' && ev.seq !== idx + 1) {
382       issues.push({
383         code: 'event_seq_break',
384         at_index: idx,
385         seq: ev.seq,
386         expected: idx + 1,
387         message: 'roadmap_events must be contiguous append-only history',
388       });
389     }
390     const kind = ev.kind;
391     const id = ev.step_id ?? ev.id ?? null;
392 
393     if (kind === 'step_create') {
394       if (!nonEmpty(id) || !nonEmpty(ev.name)) {
395         issues.push({ code: 'step_create_missing_fields', at_index: idx, step_id: id });
396         return;
397       }
398       if (steps.has(id)) {
399         issues.push({ code: 'duplicate_step_create', at_index: idx, step_id: id });
400         return;
401       }
402       const status = ROADMAP_STEP_STATUSES.includes(ev.status) ? ev.status : 'planned';
403       if (ev.part != null && !normalizePartTag(ev.part)) {
404         issues.push({ code: 'unknown_part_tag', at_index: idx, step_id: id, part: ev.part });
405       }
406       const created = {
407         id,
408         name: ev.name,
409         status,
410         done_when: ev.done_when ?? null,
411         waiting_on: ev.waiting_on ?? null,
412         commissioned_as: null,
413         part: normalizePartTag(ev.part),
414         gate: typeof ev.gate === 'string' && ev.gate.trim() ? ev.gate.trim() : null,
415       };
416       if (ev.due != null) {
417         const due = normalizeDue(ev.due);
418         if (due) created.due = due;
419         else issues.push({ code: 'invalid_due', at_index: idx, step_id: id, due: ev.due });
420       }
421       for (const [key, [norm, bad]] of Object.entries(REF_FIELD_NORMALIZERS)) {
422         if (ev[key] == null) continue;
423         const val = norm(ev[key]);
424         if (val == null) { issues.push({ code: bad, at_index: idx, step_id: id, [key]: ev[key] }); continue; }
425         if (key === 'ref') {
426           const dup = otherStepWithRef(steps, id, val);
427           if (dup) { issues.push({ code: 'duplicate_ref', at_index: idx, step_id: id, ref: val, other_step_id: dup }); continue; }
428           if (created.due != null) { issues.push({ code: 'due_on_ref_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id, ref: val }); delete created.due; }
429         }
430         created[key] = val;
431       }
432       if (Array.isArray(ev.component_ids)
433           || ev.end_to_end_slice != null
434           || ev.kickoff_version != null
435           || ev.kickoff_proposal_hash != null) {
436         created.component_ids = Array.isArray(ev.component_ids)
437           ? [...new Set(ev.component_ids.map(String).filter(Boolean))]
438           : [];
439         created.end_to_end_slice = ev.end_to_end_slice === true;
440         created.kickoff_version = Number.isInteger(ev.kickoff_version)
441           ? ev.kickoff_version : null;
442         created.kickoff_proposal_hash = typeof ev.kickoff_proposal_hash === 'string'
443           && ev.kickoff_proposal_hash.trim()
444           ? ev.kickoff_proposal_hash.trim()
445           : null;
446       }
447       steps.set(id, created);
448       return;
449     }
450 
451     if (kind === 'step_set') {
452       const step = steps.get(id);
453       if (!step) {
454         issues.push({ code: 'step_set_unknown_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id });
455         return;
456       }
457       const fields =
458         ev.fields && typeof ev.fields === 'object' ? ev.fields : {};
459       for (const key of Object.keys(fields)) {
460         if (!ROADMAP_SET_FIELDS.includes(key)) {
461           issues.push({
462             code: 'step_set_forbidden_field',
463             at_index: idx,
464             step_id: id,
465             field: key,
466             message:
467               'status requires status_flip (+ receipt); commissioned_as requires commission_bind',
468           });
469           continue;
470         }
471         if (key === 'navigation') {
472           if (!validNavigation(fields.navigation)) { issues.push({code:'invalid_navigation',at_index:idx,step_id:id}); continue; }
473           if (fields.navigation == null) delete step.navigation;
474           else step.navigation = structuredClone(fields.navigation);
475           continue;
476         }
477         if (key === 'due') {
478           if (fields.due == null) { delete step.due; continue; }
479           if (step.ref != null) { issues.push({ code: 'due_on_ref_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id, ref: step.ref }); continue; }
480           const due = normalizeDue(fields.due);
481           if (due) step.due = due;
482           else issues.push({ code: 'invalid_due', at_index: idx, step_id: id, due: fields.due });
483           continue;
484         }
485         if (key in REF_FIELD_NORMALIZERS) {
486           if (fields[key] == null) { delete step[key]; continue; }
487           const [norm, bad] = REF_FIELD_NORMALIZERS[key];
488           const val = norm(fields[key]);
489           if (val == null) { issues.push({ code: bad, at_index: idx, step_id: id, [key]: fields[key] }); continue; }
490           if (key === 'ref') {
491             const dup = otherStepWithRef(steps, id, val);
492             if (dup) { issues.push({ code: 'duplicate_ref', at_index: idx, step_id: id, ref: val, other_step_id: dup }); continue; }
493             if (step.due != null) { issues.push({ code: 'ref_on_dated_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id, ref: val }); continue; }
494           }
495           step[key] = val;
496           continue;
497         }
498         if (key === 'part') {
499           if (fields.part != null && !normalizePartTag(fields.part)) {
500             issues.push({ code: 'unknown_part_tag', at_index: idx, step_id: id, part: fields.part });
501           }
502           step.part = normalizePartTag(fields.part);
503           continue;
504         }
505         if (key === 'gate') {
506           const g = fields.gate;
507           step.gate = typeof g === 'string' && g.trim() ? g.trim() : null;
508           continue;
509         }
510         if (key === 'component_ids') {
511           step.component_ids = Array.isArray(fields.component_ids)
512             ? [...new Set(fields.component_ids.map(String).filter(Boolean))]
513             : [];
514           continue;
515         }
516         if (key === 'end_to_end_slice') {
517           step.end_to_end_slice = fields.end_to_end_slice === true;
518           continue;
519         }
520         if (key === 'active') {
521           // the active set: on or off, never a third state; off drops the order with it
522           const on = fields.active === true || fields.active === 'on' || fields.active === 'true';
523           if (on) step.active = true; else { delete step.active; delete step.active_order; }
524           continue;
525         }
526         if (key === 'active_order') {
527           const n = fields.active_order;
528           if (n == null || n === '') { delete step.active_order; continue; }
529           const v = typeof n === 'number' ? n : parseInt(String(n), 10);
530           if (Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0) step.active_order = v;
531           else issues.push({ code: 'invalid_active_order', at_index: idx, step_id: id, active_order: n });
532           continue;
533         }
534         if (key === 'pace') {
535           if (fields.pace == null || fields.pace === '') { delete step.pace; continue; }
536           const d = normalizeDue(fields.pace);
537           if (d) step.pace = d;
538           else issues.push({ code: 'invalid_pace', at_index: idx, step_id: id, pace: fields.pace });
539           continue;
540         }
541         if (key === 'seat') {
542           // the seat: active, deck, or none (back in its goal) — none drops the order with it
543           const v = fields.seat;
544           if (v == null || v === '' || v === 'none' || v === 'off') { delete step.seat; delete step.seat_order; continue; }
545           if (v === 'active' || v === 'deck') { step.seat = v; continue; }
546           issues.push({ code: 'invalid_seat', at_index: idx, step_id: id, seat: v });
547           continue;
548         }
549         if (key === 'seat_order') {
550           const n = fields.seat_order;
551           if (n == null || n === '') { delete step.seat_order; continue; }
552           const v = typeof n === 'number' ? n : parseInt(String(n), 10);
553           if (Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0) step.seat_order = v;
554           else issues.push({ code: 'invalid_seat_order', at_index: idx, step_id: id, seat_order: n });
555           continue;
556         }
557         if (key === 'kickoff_version') {
558           step.kickoff_version = Number.isInteger(fields.kickoff_version)
559             ? fields.kickoff_version : null;
560           continue;
561         }
562         if (key === 'kickoff_proposal_hash') {
563           step.kickoff_proposal_hash = typeof fields.kickoff_proposal_hash === 'string'
564             && fields.kickoff_proposal_hash.trim()
565             ? fields.kickoff_proposal_hash.trim() : null;
566           continue;
567         }
568         step[key] = fields[key];
569       }
570       return;
571     }
572 
573     if (kind === 'status_flip') {
574       const step = steps.get(id);
575       if (!step) {
576         issues.push({ code: 'status_flip_unknown_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id });
577         return;
578       }
579       if (!isValidFlipReceipt(ev.receipt)) {
580         issues.push({
581           code: 'status_flip_missing_receipt',
582           at_index: idx,
583           step_id: id,
584           message: 'status flip without receipt is rejected (not applied)',
585         });
586         return;
587       }
588       if (!ROADMAP_STEP_STATUSES.includes(ev.to)) {
589         issues.push({ code: 'status_flip_invalid_to', at_index: idx, step_id: id, to: ev.to ?? null });
590         return;
591       }
592       if (ev.from != null && ev.from !== step.status) {
593         issues.push({
594           code: 'status_flip_from_mismatch',
595           at_index: idx,
596           step_id: id,
597           from: ev.from,
598           current: step.status,
599         });
600         return;
601       }
602       if (step.ref != null) {
603         issues.push({ code: 'status_flip_on_ref_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id, ref: step.ref,
604           message: 'a referenced part is flipped in its own record, never here (not applied)' });
605         return;
606       }
607       step.status = ev.to;
608       return;
609     }
610 
611     if (kind === 'commission_bind') {
612       const step = steps.get(id);
613       if (!step) {
614         issues.push({ code: 'commission_bind_unknown_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id });
615         return;
616       }
617       if (!nonEmpty(ev.commissioned_as)) {
618         issues.push({ code: 'commission_bind_missing_target', at_index: idx, step_id: id });
619         return;
620       }
621       step.commissioned_as = ev.commissioned_as;
622       return;
623     }
624 
625     // Project-level kinds (scaffold/kickoff proposal and confirm, face_*,
626     // elaboration_*): ledger
627     // history only — no roadmap_projection fold. Detail is reconstructed by
628     // the owning surface (Face compile / progressive elaboration).
629     if (kind === 'reorder') {
630       // W4 (2026-09-28): his own act — a step moved before or after another in the plan's order; the projection
631       // is the Map's insertion order, so the move is a re-insertion
632       const step = steps.get(id);
633       if (!step) { issues.push({ code: 'reorder_unknown_step', at_index: idx, step_id: id }); return; }
634       const anchor = ev.before != null ? String(ev.before) : (ev.after != null ? String(ev.after) : null);
635       if (!anchor || anchor === String(id) || !steps.has(anchor)) { issues.push({ code: 'reorder_bad_anchor', at_index: idx, step_id: id, anchor }); return; }
636       const entries = [...steps.entries()].filter(([k]) => k !== id);
637       const at = entries.findIndex(([k]) => k === anchor);
638       entries.splice(ev.before != null ? at : at + 1, 0, [id, step]);
639       steps.clear();
640       for (const [k, v] of entries) steps.set(k, v);
641       return;
642     }
643     if (ROADMAP_PROJECT_LEVEL_KINDS.includes(kind)) {
644       return;
645     }
646 
647     issues.push({ code: 'unknown_event_kind', at_index: idx, kind: kind ?? null });
648   });
649 
650   try {
651     const refinement=foldRefinements(list);
652     for(const [id,slice] of Object.entries(refinement.slices || {})) {
653       const step=steps.get(id);
654       if(!step) { issues.push({code:'refinement_unknown_step',step_id:id}); continue; }
655       step.refinement=slice;
656       step.status=slice.phase==='done'?'done':['awaiting_review','waiting_foundation','needs_reconciliation'].includes(slice.phase)?'waiting':'active';
657       step.waiting_on=slice.phase==='awaiting_review'?'Your review of the current presentation':slice.phase==='needs_reconciliation'?'Foundation changes need reconciliation':slice.phase==='waiting_foundation'?'Foundation acceptance':null;
658     }
659   } catch(e) { issues.push({code:e.code || 'invalid-refinement-operation',message:e.message}); }
660   return {
661     ok: true,
662     projection: [...steps.values()].map(normalizeProjectionStep),
663     issues,
664     clean: issues.length === 0,
665   };
666 }
667 
668 /**
669  * @param {*} receipt
670  */
671 export function isValidFlipReceipt(receipt) {
672   if (!receipt || typeof receipt !== 'object' || Array.isArray(receipt)) return false;
673   return FLIP_RECEIPT_FIELDS.every((k) => nonEmpty(receipt[k]));
674 }
675 
676 function projectionsEqual(a, b) {
677   const na = (Array.isArray(a) ? a : []).map(normalizeProjectionStep);
678   const nb = (Array.isArray(b) ? b : []).map(normalizeProjectionStep);
679   return JSON.stringify(na) === JSON.stringify(nb);
680 }
681 
682 /**
683  * Validate a roadmap: rebuild projection from events and compare with stored.
684  * A stored projection that disagrees with the event fold is a silent rewrite
685  * (e.g. a status flip with no receipt event) → reject.
686  *
687  * Read-path allowance (`allow_unevented_steps`): a stored step whose id no
688  * event ever mentions rewrites no receipted history — the event fold stays
689  * authoritative for every evented step, and the stored-only steps ride along
690  * flagged (never silently dropped from the rail). Any drift on an evented
691  * step (field_drift / step_missing_from_stored / reorder) still rejects.
692  * Writers never pass the flag — appends onto a drifted roadmap heal first.
693  * @param {object|string} input
694  * @param {{ allow_unevented_steps?: boolean }} [opts]
695  * @returns {object}
696  */
697 export function validateRoadmap(input, opts = {}) {
698   const parsed = parseRoadmap(input);
699   if (!parsed.ok) return parsed;
700   const roadmap = parsed.roadmap;
701 
702   const built = buildRoadmapProjection(roadmap.roadmap_events);
703   const stored = roadmap.roadmap_projection;
704   const navIssues = navigationIssues(built.projection);
705   if (navIssues.length) return {ok:false,error:navIssues[0].code,issues:navIssues};
706 
707   if (stored.length > 0 && !projectionsEqual(stored, built.projection)) {
708     const drift = diffProjections(stored, built.projection);
709     const onlyUnevented =
710       drift.length > 0 && drift.every((d) => d.kind === 'step_without_events');
711 
712     if (!(onlyUnevented && opts.allow_unevented_steps === true)) {
713       return {
714         ok: false,
715         error: 'roadmap_silent_rewrite',
716         spelling: SPELLING,
717         message:
718           'Stored roadmap_projection disagrees with the append-only event fold (e.g. a status flip without a receipt event). Write refused; heal rebuilds the projection from events.',
719         drift,
720         projection_from_events: built.projection,
721         stored_projection: stored,
722         issues: built.issues,
723         heal: 'healRoadmap',
724         single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
725       };
726     }
727 
728     const evented = new Set(built.projection.map((s) => s.id));
729     const extra = stored
730       .map(normalizeProjectionStep)
731       .filter((s) => !evented.has(s.id));
732     const projection = [...built.projection, ...extra];
733     return {
734       ok: true,
735       spelling: SPELLING,
736       projection,
737       issues: [...built.issues, ...drift],
738       clean: false,
739       unevented_steps: extra.map((s) => s.id),
740       events_count: roadmap.roadmap_events.length,
741       steps_count: projection.length,
742     };
743   }
744 
745   return {
746     ok: true,
747     spelling: SPELLING,
748     projection: built.projection,
749     issues: built.issues,
750     clean: built.clean,
751     events_count: roadmap.roadmap_events.length,
752     steps_count: built.projection.length,
753   };
754 }
755 
756 function diffProjections(stored, rebuilt) {
757   const drift = [];
758   const byId = new Map(rebuilt.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
759   for (const raw of stored) {
760     const s = normalizeProjectionStep(raw);
761     const truth = byId.get(s.id);
762     if (!truth) {
763       drift.push({ step_id: s.id, kind: 'step_without_events' });
764       continue;
765     }
766     for (const field of ROADMAP_PROJECTION_FIELDS) {
767       if (JSON.stringify(s[field]) !== JSON.stringify(truth[field])) {
768         drift.push({
769           step_id: s.id,
770           kind: 'field_drift',
771           field,
772           stored: s[field],
773           from_events: truth[field],
774         });
775       }
776     }
777   }
778   for (const truth of rebuilt) {
779     if (!stored.some((s) => normalizeProjectionStep(s).id === truth.id)) {
780       drift.push({ step_id: truth.id, kind: 'step_missing_from_stored' });
781     }
782   }
783   return drift;
784 }
785 
786 /**
787  * Heal: rebuild roadmap_projection from roadmap_events.
788  * Events are never rewritten — projection is derived-only.
789  * @param {object|string} input
790  */
791 export function healRoadmap(input) {
792   const parsed = parseRoadmap(input);
793   if (!parsed.ok) return parsed;
794   const roadmap = parsed.roadmap;
795 
796   const priorEvents = roadmap.roadmap_events.map((e) => ({ ...e }));
797   const built = buildRoadmapProjection(roadmap.roadmap_events);
798 
799   const healed = {
800     ...roadmap,
801     roadmap_events: priorEvents,
802     roadmap_projection: built.projection,
803   };
804 
805   return {
806     ok: true,
807     spelling: SPELLING,
808     healed: true,
809     roadmap: healed,
810     projection: built.projection,
811     issues: built.issues,
812     events_rewritten: false,
813     message:
814       'roadmap_projection rebuilt from append-only roadmap_events; event history untouched',
815   };
816 }
817 
818 /**
819  * Append a roadmap event — THE single writer path.
820  * Refuses: unknown kinds, status_flip without receipt, step_set on
821  * status/commissioned_as, unknown/duplicate steps, and appends onto a
822  * roadmap whose stored projection already drifted (heal first).
823  * Never mutates the input roadmap; projection is rebuilt from the full list.
824  * @param {object|string} roadmapInput
825  * @param {object} event
826  * @param {{ at?: string }} [opts]
827  */
828 export function appendRoadmapEvent(roadmapInput, event, opts = {}) {
829   const parsed = parseRoadmap(roadmapInput ?? emptyRoadmap());
830   if (!parsed.ok) return parsed;
831   const roadmap = parsed.roadmap;
832 
833   if (!event || typeof event !== 'object' || Array.isArray(event)) {
834     return { ok: false, error: 'event_not_object', spelling: SPELLING };
835   }
836   const kind = event.kind;
837   if (!ROADMAP_EVENT_KINDS.includes(kind)) {
838     return {
839       ok: false,
840       error: 'unknown_roadmap_event_kind',
841       spelling: SPELLING,
842       kind: kind ?? null,
843       event_kinds: [...ROADMAP_EVENT_KINDS],
844     };
845   }
846 
847   // T-IDEM-06: caller-supplied client_event_id — re-append is a no-op, original seq.
848   if (typeof event.client_event_id === 'string' && event.client_event_id.trim()) {
849     const prior = roadmap.roadmap_events.find(
850       (e) => e && e.client_event_id === event.client_event_id,
851     );
852     if (prior) {
853       return {
854         ok: true,
855         spelling: SPELLING,
856         authority: 'roadmap_append_only',
857         idempotent: true,
858         client_event_id: event.client_event_id,
859         seq: prior.seq,
860         event: prior,
861         roadmap,
862         projection: roadmap.roadmap_projection,
863         events_only: true,
864         single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
865       };
866     }
867   }
868 
869   // T-BND-06: refuse past the named bound — never truncate.
870   if (roadmap.roadmap_events.length >= ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX) {
871     return {
872       ok: false,
873       error: 'events-bound-exceeded',
874       spelling: SPELLING,
875       bound: ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX,
876       count: roadmap.roadmap_events.length,
877       message:
878         'Ledger at its 50000-event bound — append refused by name, never truncated.',
879     };
880   }
881 
882   // Guard: a drifted stored projection means someone rewrote silently — refuse
883   // the write until an explicit heal rebuilds from events.
884   const validated = validateRoadmap(roadmap);
885   if (!validated.ok) {
886     return {
887       ...validated,
888       refused_write: true,
889       message: `${validated.message} Append refused until heal.`,
890     };
891   }
892 
893   const current = new Map(
894     validated.projection.map((s) => [s.id, s]),
895   );
896   const step_id = event.step_id ?? event.id ?? null;
897 
898   if (ROADMAP_PROJECT_LEVEL_KINDS.includes(kind)) {
899     // Project-level events (Wave 9 scaffold_proposal; Wave 10 face_*;
900     // Wave 12 elaboration_*). No step mutation — admitted so authoring /
901     // Face compile / progressive elaboration cannot invent a parallel sink
902     // outside the versioned allow-list. elaboration_* join a step via step_id
903     // in the event body; reconstructStepDetail folds answers.
904   } else if (kind === 'step_create') {
905     if (!nonEmpty(step_id) || !nonEmpty(event.name)) {
906       return {
907         ok: false,
908         error: 'step_create_missing_fields',
909         spelling: SPELLING,
910         required: ['step_id', 'name'],
911       };
912     }
913     if (current.has(step_id)) {
914       return { ok: false, error: 'duplicate_step_id', spelling: SPELLING, step_id };
915     }
916     if (event.status != null && !ROADMAP_STEP_STATUSES.includes(event.status)) {
917       return {
918         ok: false,
919         error: 'invalid_step_status',
920         spelling: SPELLING,
921         status: event.status,
922         statuses: [...ROADMAP_STEP_STATUSES],
923       };
924     }
925     if (event.due != null && !normalizeDue(event.due)) {
926       return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_due', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, due: event.due, expected: 'YYYY-MM-DD' };
927     }
928     for (const [key, [norm, bad]] of Object.entries(REF_FIELD_NORMALIZERS)) {
929       if (event[key] != null && norm(event[key]) == null) {
930         return { ok: false, error: bad, spelling: SPELLING, step_id, [key]: event[key] };
931       }
932     }
933     if (event.ref != null) {
934       const dup = otherStepWithRef(current, step_id, normalizeRef(event.ref));
935       if (dup) return { ok: false, error: 'duplicate_ref', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, ref: event.ref, other_step_id: dup };
936       if (event.due != null) return { ok: false, error: 'due_on_ref_step', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, ref: event.ref, message: 'a referenced part takes its date from its own record' };
937     }
938   } else {
939     if (!nonEmpty(step_id) || !current.has(step_id)) {
940       return { ok: false, error: 'unknown_step', spelling: SPELLING, step_id: step_id ?? null };
941     }
942   }
943 
944   if (kind === 'status_flip') {
945     if (!isValidFlipReceipt(event.receipt)) {
946       return {
947         ok: false,
948         error: 'status_flip_requires_receipt',
949         spelling: SPELLING,
950         step_id,
951         required: [...FLIP_RECEIPT_FIELDS],
952         message:
953           'Status flip without a receipt event is refused. Provide receipt { who, why } (when defaults to the event date).',
954         single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
955       };
956     }
957     if (!ROADMAP_STEP_STATUSES.includes(event.to)) {
958       return {
959         ok: false,
960         error: 'invalid_step_status',
961         spelling: SPELLING,
962         status: event.to ?? null,
963         statuses: [...ROADMAP_STEP_STATUSES],
964       };
965     }
966     const cur = current.get(step_id);
967     if (cur && cur.ref != null) {
968       return { ok: false, error: 'status_flip_on_ref_step', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, ref: cur.ref,
969         message: 'a referenced part is flipped in its own record, never here' };
970     }
971     if (event.from != null && event.from !== cur.status) {
972       return {
973         ok: false,
974         error: 'status_flip_from_mismatch',
975         spelling: SPELLING,
976         step_id,
977         from: event.from,
978         current: cur.status,
979       };
980     }
981   }
982 
983   if (kind === 'step_set') {
984     const fields =
985       event.fields && typeof event.fields === 'object' ? event.fields : {};
986     if ('navigation' in fields && !validNavigation(fields.navigation)) return {ok:false,error:'invalid_navigation'};
987     if (fields.due != null && !normalizeDue(fields.due)) {
988       return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_due', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, due: fields.due, expected: 'YYYY-MM-DD' };
989     }
990     if (fields.pace != null && fields.pace !== '' && !normalizeDue(fields.pace)) {
991       return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_pace', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, pace: fields.pace, expected: 'YYYY-MM-DD or none' };
992     }
993     if (fields.active_order != null && fields.active_order !== '') {
994       const v = typeof fields.active_order === 'number' ? fields.active_order : parseInt(String(fields.active_order), 10);
995       if (!Number.isInteger(v) || v < 0) {
996         return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_active_order', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, active_order: fields.active_order, expected: 'an integer from 0' };
997       }
998     }
999     if (fields.active != null && ![true, false, 'on', 'off', 'true', 'false'].includes(fields.active)) {
1000       return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_active', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, active: fields.active, expected: 'on or off' };
1001     }
1002     if (fields.seat != null && fields.seat !== '' && !['none', 'off', 'active', 'deck'].includes(fields.seat)) {
1003       return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_seat', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, seat: fields.seat, expected: 'active, deck or none' };
1004     }
1005     if (fields.seat_order != null && fields.seat_order !== '') {
1006       const v = typeof fields.seat_order === 'number' ? fields.seat_order : parseInt(String(fields.seat_order), 10);
1007       if (!Number.isInteger(v) || v < 0) {
1008         return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_seat_order', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, seat_order: fields.seat_order, expected: 'an integer from 0' };
1009       }
1010     }
1011     for (const [key, [norm, bad]] of Object.entries(REF_FIELD_NORMALIZERS)) {
1012       if (fields[key] != null && norm(fields[key]) == null) {
1013         return { ok: false, error: bad, spelling: SPELLING, step_id, [key]: fields[key] };
1014       }
1015     }
1016     {
1017       const cur = current.get(step_id) || {};
1018       if (fields.ref != null) {
1019         const dup = otherStepWithRef(current, step_id, normalizeRef(fields.ref));
1020         if (dup) return { ok: false, error: 'duplicate_ref', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, ref: fields.ref, other_step_id: dup };
1021         if (cur.due != null || fields.due != null) return { ok: false, error: 'ref_on_dated_step', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, ref: fields.ref, message: 'a referenced part takes its date from its own record' };
1022       }
1023       if (fields.due != null && cur.ref != null && !('ref' in fields && fields.ref == null)) {
1024         return { ok: false, error: 'due_on_ref_step', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, ref: cur.ref, message: 'a referenced part takes its date from its own record' };
1025       }
1026     }
1027     const forbidden = Object.keys(fields).filter(
1028       (k) => !ROADMAP_SET_FIELDS.includes(k),
1029     );
1030     if (!Object.keys(fields).length) {
1031       return {
1032         ok: false,
1033         error: 'step_set_requires_fields',
1034         spelling: SPELLING,
1035         allowed: [...ROADMAP_SET_FIELDS],
1036       };
1037     }
1038     if (forbidden.length) {
1039       return {
1040         ok: false,
1041         error: 'step_set_forbidden_field',
1042         spelling: SPELLING,
1043         forbidden,
1044         allowed: [...ROADMAP_SET_FIELDS],
1045         message:
1046           'status requires status_flip (+ receipt); commissioned_as requires commission_bind (TW3 single-writer hook)',
1047       };
1048     }
1049   }
1050 
1051   if (kind === 'reorder') {
1052     const have = new Set(roadmap.roadmap_projection.map((s) => String(s.id)));
1053     const anchor = event.before != null ? String(event.before) : (event.after != null ? String(event.after) : null);
1054     if (!nonEmpty(step_id) || !have.has(String(step_id)) || !anchor || anchor === String(step_id) || !have.has(anchor)) {
1055       return { ok: false, error: 'reorder_invalid', spelling: SPELLING, step_id: step_id ?? null, anchor,
1056                message: 'reorder needs an existing step_id and an existing before/after step that is not itself.' };
1057     }
1058     if (!(event.receipt && typeof event.receipt === 'object' && nonEmpty(event.receipt.who))) {
1059       return { ok: false, error: 'reorder_needs_receipt', spelling: SPELLING, step_id, message: 'reorder is his act: it carries a receipt (who, why).' };
1060     }
1061   }
1062   if (kind === 'commission_bind' && !nonEmpty(event.commissioned_as)) {
1063     return {
1064       ok: false,
1065       error: 'commission_bind_missing_target',
1066       spelling: SPELLING,
1067       step_id,
1068     };
1069   }
1070 
1071   if (kind === 'step_set' && event.fields && 'navigation' in event.fields && !validNavigation(event.fields.navigation)) return {ok:false,error:'invalid_navigation'};
1072   const at = event.at ?? opts.at ?? todayIso();
1073   const normalized = {
1074     ...event,
1075     seq: roadmap.roadmap_events.length + 1,
1076     kind,
1077     step_id: kind === 'scaffold_proposal' ? (step_id ?? null) : step_id,
1078     at,
1079   };
1080   if (typeof event.client_event_id === 'string' && event.client_event_id.trim()) {
1081     normalized.client_event_id = event.client_event_id;
1082   }
1083   if (kind === 'status_flip') {
1084     normalized.from = event.from ?? current.get(step_id).status;
1085     normalized.receipt = {
1086       who: event.receipt.who,
1087       when: event.receipt.when ?? at,
1088       why: event.receipt.why,
1089     };
1090   }
1091   delete normalized.id;
1092 
1093   const events = [...roadmap.roadmap_events.map((e) => ({ ...e })), normalized];
1094   let refinement;
1095   try { refinement=foldRefinements(events); }
1096   catch(e) { return {ok:false,error:e.code || 'invalid-refinement-operation',detail:e.message}; }
1097   const built = buildRoadmapProjection(events);
1098   const navIssues = navigationIssues(built.projection);
1099   if (navIssues.length) return {ok:false,error:navIssues[0].code,issues:navIssues};
1100 
1101   return {
1102     ok: true,
1103     spelling: SPELLING,
1104     authority: 'roadmap_append_only',
1105     event: normalized,
1106     seq: normalized.seq,
1107     idempotent: false,
1108     roadmap: {
1109       ...roadmap,
1110       as_of: at,
1111       roadmap_events: events,
1112       roadmap_projection: built.projection,
1113       ...(refinement.managed ? {refinement_projection:refinement} : {}),
1114     },
1115     projection: built.projection,
1116     issues: built.issues,
1117     events_only: true,
1118     single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
1119   };
1120 }
1121

1125  * @param {object} [patch]
1126  */
1127 export function mutateRoadmapProjectionInPlace(roadmap, patch = {}) {
1128   return {
1129     ok: false,
1130     error: 'roadmap_projection_write_rejected',
1131     spelling: SPELLING,
1132     message:
1133       'roadmap_projection is derived from append-only roadmap_events; direct writes are rejected. Use roadmap-propose / roadmap-set → appendRoadmapEvent (single writer), or healRoadmap to rebuild from events.',
1134     attempted_fields: Object.keys(patch || {}),

1140 /**
1141  * Load a project's roadmap.json (N=1 path; no registry).
1142  * @param {string} projectPath
1143  */
1144 export function loadProjectRoadmap(projectPath) {
1145   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
1146   const roadmapPath = path.join(root, ROADMAP_FILE_NAME);
1147   if (!fs.existsSync(roadmapPath) || !fs.statSync(roadmapPath).isFile()) {
1148     return { ok: true, exists: false, roadmap: null, roadmap_path: roadmapPath };
1149   }
1150   try {
1151     const raw = fs.readFileSync(roadmapPath, 'utf8');
1152     const parsed = parseRoadmap(raw);
1153     if (!parsed.ok) {
1154       return { ok: false, exists: true, roadmap: null, roadmap_path: roadmapPath, ...parsed };
1155     }
1156     return { ok: true, exists: true, roadmap: parsed.roadmap, roadmap_path: roadmapPath };
1157   } catch (e) {
1158     return {
1159       ok: false,
1160       exists: true,
1161       roadmap: null,
1162       roadmap_path: roadmapPath,
1163       error: 'roadmap_read_failed',
1164       message: String(e?.message ?? e),
1165     };
1166   }
1167 }

1169 /**
1170  * The container's bytes, in ONE place.
1171  *
1172  * W15 needs these bytes twice - once to write the file and once to hash it into the
1173  * commit-intent that asks for it to be committed - and two spellings of the same
1174  * serialization is how a durability receipt ends up naming a hash the file on disk does not
1175  * have. So the writer below calls this, and so does the intent.
1176  *
1177  * @param {object} roadmap @returns {string}
1178  */
1179 export function projectRoadmapBytes(roadmap) {
1180   return `${JSON.stringify(roadmap, null, 2)}\n`;
1181 }
1182 
1183 /**
1184  * Persist a roadmap container to the project root.
1185  *
1186  * Wave 6: whole-file rewrite is serialised under the SAME named lock as the
1187  * spine (`withFileLock` + `writeFileAtomicSync`). Production appends still go
1188  * through `appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine` / `appendRoadmapEventDurable`; this
1189  * helper is the fixture/heal container path — never an unlocked second writer.
1190  *
1191  * @param {string} projectPath
1192  * @param {object} roadmap
1193  * @param {{ timeoutMs?: number }} [opts]
1194  */
1195 export function writeProjectRoadmap(projectPath, roadmap, opts = {}) {
1196   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
1197   const roadmapPath = path.join(root, ROADMAP_FILE_NAME);
1198   fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
1199   withFileLock(
1200     roadmapPath,
1201     () => {
1202       writeFileAtomicSync(roadmapPath, projectRoadmapBytes(roadmap));
1203     },
1204     { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs },
1205   );
1206   return {
1207     ok: true,
1208     roadmap_path: roadmapPath,
1209     locked: true,
1210     lock: 'withFileLock',
1211     atomic_write: 'writeFileAtomicSync',
1212   };
1213 }

1215 // -- W9: the durable, indexed half of the single writer -----------------------

1217 /**
1218  * The id used when a roadmap container names neither a roadmap nor a project. Named rather
1219  * than inlined so the carrier path is predictable in the one case where nothing else is.
1220  */
1221 export const ROADMAP_DEFAULT_ID = 'roadmap';
1222 
1223 /**
1224  * The roadmap a carrier file belongs to.
1225  *
1226  * @param {object} roadmap @param {{roadmap_id?: string}} [opts] @returns {string}
1227  */
1228 export function roadmapIdFor(roadmap, opts = {}) {
1229   const id = opts.roadmap_id ?? roadmap?.roadmap_id ?? roadmap?.project_id ?? null;
1230   return nonEmpty(id) ? String(id) : ROADMAP_DEFAULT_ID;

1233 /**
1234  * The inventory-v1 roadmap-event record for one appended event.
1235  *
1236  * WHY A MAPPING EXISTS AT ALL. The engine's roadmap event and the index's roadmap-event
1237  * class are two vocabularies that happen to describe the same fact: the engine speaks
1238  * {kind, step_id, at, receipt}, and inventory-v1 plus the frozen `proj` field set ask for
1239  * {event_id, roadmap_id, kind, title, step_status}. This function is the ONE place they are
1240  * lined up, so the carrier a rebuild discovers and the row the write path emitted describe
1241  * the same event in the same words. It invents no authority: appendRoadmapEvent has already
1242  * decided what the event IS and what the projection became, and every value here is read
1243  * back out of that decision.
1244  *
1245  * `title` and `step_status` come from the PROJECTION rather than from the raw event, because
1246  * the projection is the fold the single writer already computed - reading the status off the
1247  * event would re-derive it, and a second derivation is a second answer.
1248  *
1249  * @param {object} roadmap the container AFTER the append
1250  * @param {object} event the normalized event appendRoadmapEvent produced
1251  * @param {{roadmap_id?: string, event_id?: string}} [opts]
1252  * @returns {object}
1253  */
1254 export function roadmapEventCarrierRecord(roadmap, event, opts = {}) {
1255   const roadmap_id = roadmapIdFor(roadmap, opts);
1256   const steps = Array.isArray(roadmap?.roadmap_projection) ? roadmap.roadmap_projection : [];
1257   const step = steps.find((s) => s && s.id === event.step_id) ?? null;
1258   return {
1259     event_id: nonEmpty(opts.event_id) ? String(opts.event_id) : `${roadmap_id}-${event.seq}`,
1260     roadmap_id,
1261     kind: event.kind,
1262     title: step && step.name != null ? step.name : (event.name ?? null),
1263     step_status: step && step.status != null ? step.status : (event.to ?? null),
1264     step_id: event.step_id ?? null,
1265     seq: event.seq,
1266     // inventory-v1 declares {event_id, phase, ts} as this class's field set; `phase` is the
1267     // event's kind and `ts` its stamp, named here so the census reads the same values the
1268     // index does.
1269     phase: event.kind,
1270     ts: event.at,
1271   };
1272 }
1273 
1274 /**
1275  * The bytes one roadmap event is stored as: ONE JSONL line, one event per carrier file.
1276  *
1277  * inventory-v1 frames this class as `<root>/roadmap/*.jsonl (one event per line)`, which a
1278  * single-line file satisfies. Writing one event per file rather than accumulating them is
1279  * what makes a just-appended roadmap event findable: identity is the PATH, so a file holding
1280  * many events is one row projecting one of them, and the newest event would be invisible
1281  * behind its oldest sibling. One file per event makes roadmap-event a literal peer of
1282  * receipt - one item, one row, one `proj`.
1283  *
1284  * @param {object} record @returns {string}
1285  */
1286 export function roadmapEventBytes(record) {
1287   return `${JSON.stringify(record)}\n`;
1288 }
1289 
1290 /**
1291  * appendRoadmapEvent, made durable and findable - the W9 write path for class
1292  * roadmap-event, and class-symmetry leg 4.
1293  *
1294  * Wave 6: production path is the ledger spine (named withFileLock on roadmap.json
1295  * + writeFileAtomicSync). The whole-file-rewrite of the campaign ledger is
1296  * serialised under that lock; when project_id is supplied the inventory carrier
1297  * + portfolio index flush still run (outside the roadmap lock, lock-order law).
1298  *
1299  * @param {string} projectPath the registered root
1300  * @param {object|string} roadmapInput @param {object} event
1301  * @param {{project_id?: string, home?: string, paths?: object, env?: object, at?: string,
1302  *          roadmap_id?: string, event_id?: string, beforeFlush?: Function,
1303  *          appendOpts?: object, skip_index?: boolean, timeoutMs?: number}} opts
1304  * @returns {object}
1305  */
1306 export function appendRoadmapEventDurable(projectPath, roadmapInput, event, opts = {}) {
1307   return appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(projectPath, event, {
1308     ...opts,
1309     seed: roadmapInput === undefined ? undefined : roadmapInput,
1310     at: opts.at,
1311     project_id: opts.project_id,
1312     home: opts.home,
1313     paths: opts.paths,
1314     env: opts.env,
1315     // Without project_id there is no portfolio index identity — locked SoT only.
1316     skip_index: opts.skip_index === true || !opts.project_id,
1317     roadmap_id: opts.roadmap_id,
1318     event_id: opts.event_id,
1319     beforeFlush: opts.beforeFlush,
1320     appendOpts: opts.appendOpts,
1321     timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs,
1322   });
1323 }

1325 /** Slug id from a step name. */
1326 function slugFromName(name) {
1327   const slug = String(name ?? '')
1328     .toLowerCase()
1329     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
1330     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
1331     .slice(0, 48);
1332   return slug || 'step';
1333 }

1335 function resolveRoadmapSurfaces(opts = {}) {
1336   const project_path = resolveProjectPath({ project: opts.project, cwd: opts.cwd });
1337   const loaded =
1338     opts.roadmap !== undefined
1339       ? {
1340           ok: true,
1341           exists: opts.roadmap != null,
1342           roadmap: opts.roadmap,
1343           roadmap_path: null,
1344           injected: true,
1345         }
1346       : loadProjectRoadmap(project_path);
1347   return { project_path, loaded };
1348 }

1350 /**
1351  * roadmap-show — status projection from the append-only events.
1352  * Face-only prose → empty projection + honest gap (never invented steps).
1353  * @param {object} opts
1354  */
1355 export function verbRoadmapShow(opts = {}) {
1356   const { project_path, loaded } = resolveRoadmapSurfaces(opts);
1357 
1358   if (!loaded.ok) {
1359     return {
1360       ok: false,
1361       error: loaded.error ?? 'roadmap_read_failed',
1362       spelling: SPELLING,
1363       verb: 'roadmap-show',
1364       primary: 'roadmap-show',
1365       project_path,
1366       message: loaded.message ?? 'roadmap.json unreadable',
1367     };
1368   }
1369 
1370   if (!loaded.exists) {
1371     const surfaces = opts.surfaces ?? loadProjectSurfaces(project_path);
1372     const face_only = Boolean(surfaces && (surfaces.face || surfaces.strip));
1373     const gap = surfaces && surfaces.face ? 'face_prose_only' : 'no_roadmap';
1374     return {
1375       ok: true,
1376       spelling: SPELLING,
1377       verb: 'roadmap-show',
1378       primary: 'roadmap-show',
1379       project_path,
1380       roadmap_present: false,
1381       projection: [],
1382       steps_count: 0,
1383       events_count: 0,
1384       gap,
1385       honest_gap: true,
1386       invented_steps: false,
1387       face_prose_consulted: face_only && gap === 'face_prose_only',
1388       message:
1389         gap === 'face_prose_only'
1390           ? 'Face prose exists but there is no engine Roadmap; projection is empty (honest gap — steps are never invented from prose).'
1391           : 'No Roadmap for this project; projection is empty.',
1392     };
1393   }
1394 
1395   const validated = validateRoadmap(loaded.roadmap);
1396   if (!validated.ok) {
1397     return {
1398       ...validated,
1399       verb: 'roadmap-show',
1400       primary: 'roadmap-show',
1401       project_path,
1402       roadmap_present: true,
1403     };
1404   }
1405 
1406   return {
1407     ok: true,
1408     spelling: SPELLING,
1409     verb: 'roadmap-show',
1410     primary: 'roadmap-show',
1411     project_path,
1412     roadmap_present: true,
1413     projection: validated.projection,
1414     steps_count: validated.steps_count,
1415     events_count: validated.events_count,
1416     issues: validated.issues,
1417     gap: null,
1418     invented_steps: false,
1419     message: 'Roadmap projection derived from append-only events (engine truth).',
1420   };
1421 }

1423 /**
1424  * roadmap-propose — propose a step → step_create event only (status proposed).
1425  * @param {object} opts
1426  */
1427 export function verbRoadmapPropose(opts = {}) {
1428   const name = opts.name ?? opts.rest?.[0] ?? null;
1429   if (!nonEmpty(name)) {
1430     return {
1431       ok: false,
1432       error: 'roadmap_propose_requires_name',
1433       spelling: SPELLING,
1434       verb: 'roadmap-propose',
1435       primary: 'roadmap-propose',
1436       message: 'roadmap-propose requires --name (step name).',
1437       required: ['name'],
1438     };
1439   }
1440 
1441   const { project_path, loaded } = resolveRoadmapSurfaces(opts);
1442   if (!loaded.ok) {
1443     return {
1444       ok: false,
1445       error: loaded.error ?? 'roadmap_read_failed',
1446       spelling: SPELLING,
1447       verb: 'roadmap-propose',
1448       primary: 'roadmap-propose',
1449       project_path,
1450       message: loaded.message ?? 'roadmap.json unreadable',
1451     };
1452   }
1453 
1454   const base = loaded.exists ? loaded.roadmap : emptyRoadmap(opts.project_id ?? null);
1455   const step_id = nonEmpty(opts.step) ? opts.step : slugFromName(name);
1456 
1457   const event = {
1458     kind: 'step_create',
1459     step_id,
1460     name,
1461     status: 'proposed',
1462     done_when: opts.done_when ?? null,
1463     waiting_on: opts.waiting_on ?? null,
1464     ...(opts.due != null ? { due: opts.due } : {}),
1465     ...(opts.ref != null ? { ref: opts.ref } : {}),
1466     ...(opts.tier != null ? { tier: opts.tier } : {}),
1467     ...(opts.area != null ? { area: opts.area } : {}),
1468     at: opts.as_of ?? undefined,
1469     ...(opts.client_event_id ? { client_event_id: opts.client_event_id } : {}),
1470   };
1471 
1472   const persist = opts.persist !== false && !opts.dry_run && !loaded.injected;
1473   const written = { roadmap: false };
1474   let appended;
1475 
1476   if (persist) {
1477     // Wave 6 live-writer migration (roadmap.mjs:1000): production persist via spine.
1478     // appendRoadmapEventDurable is the named durable entry (A5 production caller).
1479     appended = appendRoadmapEventDurable(project_path, base, event, {
1480       project_id: opts.project_id ?? base?.project_id ?? null,
1481       home: opts.home,
1482       paths: opts.paths,
1483       env: opts.env,
1484       at: opts.as_of,
1485       skip_index: !opts.project_id && !opts.home,
1486     });
1487     if (!appended.ok) {
1488       return {
1489         ...appended,
1490         verb: 'roadmap-propose',
1491         primary: 'roadmap-propose',
1492         project_path,
1493       };
1494     }
1495     written.roadmap = appended.sot_written === true || appended.persisted === true;
1496   } else {
1497     appended = appendRoadmapEvent(base, event);
1498     if (!appended.ok) {
1499       return {
1500         ...appended,
1501         verb: 'roadmap-propose',
1502         primary: 'roadmap-propose',
1503         project_path,
1504       };
1505     }
1506   }
1507 
1508   return {
1509     ok: true,
1510     spelling: SPELLING,
1511     verb: 'roadmap-propose',
1512     primary: 'roadmap-propose',
1513     project_path,
1514     event: appended.event,
1515     roadmap: appended.roadmap,
1516     projection: appended.projection,
1517     step_id,
1518     events_only: true,
1519     projection_written_directly: false,
1520     single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
1521     persisted: written,
1522     dry_run: Boolean(opts.dry_run) || opts.persist === false,
1523     spine: persist ? true : undefined,
1524     message: `Step '${step_id}' proposed via step_create event (events only; projection derived).`,
1525   };
1526 }
1527 
1528 /**
1529  * roadmap-set — events only:
1530  * - --status <to> flips status (receipt --who/--reason required; refuse without)
1531  * - --commissioned-as binds a commission (TW3 hook path)
1532  * - --name/--done-when/--waiting-on/--due/--ref/--tier/--area emit step_set
1533  * @param {object} opts
1534  */
1535 export function verbRoadmapSet(opts = {}) {
1536   const step_id = opts.step ?? null;
1537   if (!nonEmpty(step_id)) {
1538     return {
1539       ok: false,
1540       error: 'roadmap_set_requires_step',
1541       spelling: SPELLING,
1542       verb: 'roadmap-set',
1543       primary: 'roadmap-set',
1544       message: 'roadmap-set requires --step <id>.',
1545       required: ['step'],
1546     };
1547   }
1548 
1549   const { project_path, loaded } = resolveRoadmapSurfaces(opts);
1550   if (!loaded.ok) {
1551     return {
1552       ok: false,
1553       error: loaded.error ?? 'roadmap_read_failed',
1554       spelling: SPELLING,
1555       verb: 'roadmap-set',
1556       primary: 'roadmap-set',
1557       project_path,
1558       message: loaded.message ?? 'roadmap.json unreadable',
1559     };
1560   }
1561   if (!loaded.exists) {
1562     return {
1563       ok: false,
1564       error: 'no_roadmap',
1565       spelling: SPELLING,
1566       verb: 'roadmap-set',
1567       primary: 'roadmap-set',
1568       project_path,
1569       message:
1570         'No engine Roadmap for this project — nothing to set. Propose steps first (roadmap-propose); prose is not a step list.',
1571     };
1572   }
1573 
1574   let event;
1575   if (opts.status != null) {
1576     const receipt =
1577       opts.receipt && typeof opts.receipt === 'object'
1578         ? opts.receipt
1579         : { who: opts.who ?? null, when: opts.when ?? null, why: opts.reason ?? opts.why ?? null };
1580     if (!isValidFlipReceipt(receipt)) {
1581       return {
1582         ok: false,
1583         error: 'status_flip_requires_receipt',
1584         spelling: SPELLING,
1585         verb: 'roadmap-set',
1586         primary: 'roadmap-set',
1587         project_path,
1588         step_id,
1589         required: [...FLIP_RECEIPT_FIELDS],
1590         message:
1591           'Status flip refused without receipt: pass --who and --reason (who/why; when defaults to event date).',
1592         single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
1593       };
1594     }
1595     if (opts.status === 'done') {
1596       // cockpit Wave B: the steward's close states the next act and the goal re-read first
1597       const demand = demandClose(project_path, loaded.roadmap, step_id, opts.goal_reread ?? null);
1598       if (!demand.ok) return { ...demand, spelling: SPELLING, verb: 'roadmap-set', primary: 'roadmap-set', project_path, step_id };
1599     }
1600     event = {
1601       kind: 'status_flip',
1602       step_id,
1603       from: opts.from ?? null,
1604       to: opts.status,
1605       receipt,
1606       at: opts.as_of ?? undefined,
1607       ...(opts.goal_reread ? { goal_reread: opts.goal_reread } : {}),
1608       ...(opts.client_event_id ? { client_event_id: opts.client_event_id } : {}),
1609     };
1610     if (event.from == null) delete event.from;
1611   } else if (nonEmpty(opts.commissioned_as)) {
1612     event = {
1613       kind: 'commission_bind',
1614       step_id,
1615       commissioned_as: opts.commissioned_as,
1616       at: opts.as_of ?? undefined,
1617       ...(opts.client_event_id ? { client_event_id: opts.client_event_id } : {}),
1618     };
1619   } else {
1620     const fields = {};
1621     if (opts.name != null) fields.name = opts.name;
1622     if (opts.done_when != null) fields.done_when = opts.done_when;
1623     if (opts.waiting_on != null) fields.waiting_on = opts.waiting_on;
1624     if (opts.due != null) fields.due = (opts.due === 'none' || opts.due === '') ? null : opts.due;
1625     for (const key of ['ref', 'tier', 'area']) {
1626       if (opts[key] != null) fields[key] = (opts[key] === 'none' || opts[key] === '') ? null : opts[key];
1627     }
1628     // the active set (2026-09-29): --active on|off · --active-order N|none · --pace YYYY-MM-DD|none
1629     if (opts.active != null) fields.active = !(opts.active === 'off' || opts.active === 'false' || opts.active === false);
1630     if (opts.active_order != null) fields.active_order = (opts.active_order === 'none' || opts.active_order === '') ? null : opts.active_order;
1631     if (opts.pace != null) fields.pace = (opts.pace === 'none' || opts.pace === '') ? null : opts.pace;
1632     // the seats (2026-09-30): --seat-in active|deck|none · --seat-order N|none (--seat alone is the model seat)
